summary: Frontend-only verification (preview URL) of consulting enquiry submission + Google Ads tag placement + admin flow. All 7 target scenarios PASS.

double_click_guard.details: Second rapid click on Submit Enquiry blocked - button becomes disabled while isSubmitting. Exactly ONE POST /api/ai-consulting-enquiries observed per submission (network capture).

google_ads_tag_public_pages.details: For /, /consulting, /solutions, /research, /about-us, /careers, /contact: exactly 1 script src=https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=AW-18460200148, exactly 1 inline gtag block containing AW-18460200148, window.dataLayer present with entries, gtag network request loaded (200-class, no errors). No CSP violations or JS errors related to gtag in console.

direct_visits_include_tag.details: Direct navigations (not client-side transitions) to /consulting, /about-us etc served HTML with the gtag script and inline config (verified via both DOM inspection and curl on preview URL).

admin_excludes_tag.details: GET /admin: 0 gtag scripts, 0 inline gtag config for AW-18460200148, 0 googletagmanager network requests. curl of raw HTML confirms 0 occurrences of AW-18460200148.

admin_login_flow.details: POST /api/admin/login=200, dashboard rendered with Consultation Enquiries + Contact Forms tiles, GET /api/admin/verify (with cookie)=200. POST /api/admin/logout=200 via admin-header-logout data-testid. Post-logout GET /api/admin/verify=401.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend rejects emails using RFC-6761 reserved TLD .test (deliverability check via email_validator). This blocked our first attempt (`@blubridge-qa.test` -> 422 with message: 'The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.'). This is CORRECT strict behaviour; documenting so next agent uses a real TLD for QA fixtures (used .dev instead).

Two logout buttons exist in the admin shell with distinct data-testids (admin-sidebar-logout, admin-header-logout). Both target the same handler; strict-mode role selectors will collide - always use the data-testid.
Success block placement: Success message renders ABOVE the form (still visible on desktop and mobile) - the aic-success node is scrolled into view. Working as designed.
test_credentials: Admin creds read from /app/backend/.env via dotenv_values (never printed).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 QA consulting enquiries (78020c25... and d120ab34...) via UI. Both cleaned up post-test via direct MongoDB delete on contact_enquiries collection by company_email - verified deleted_count=2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All fixes for cross-site form POST + Google Ads static tag placement verified in real browser at preview URL. Consulting enquiries are stored in the contact_enquiries collection keyed on company_email (NOT ai_consulting_enquiries). If seeding QA emails, avoid RFC-6761 reserved TLDs (.test/.example/.invalid/.localhost) - use .dev / .com / .io etc. Radix Select dropdowns in ai-consulting-base can be flaky under fast automation - the pick_dropdown helper (open+retry with Escape between attempts) worked reliably.
rca of the issue: N/A - user-reported production issues (cross-site 403 + missing gtag on static hosting) are fully addressed in the preview build: (a) submission uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and works cross-site with signed HMAC form-token; (b) gtag baked into public/index.html so it renders even without Express injection, and Express injector strips it on /admin.
